title: Steel Structure Design Services in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel structure design for PEB buildings, sheds, warehouses and mezzanines in Pakistan. Loads, frames and 3D models by Steel Mind Engineers engineers.
h1: Steel Structure Design in Pakistan: Engineering for Safe, Efficient Buildings
quickAnswer: Design is the first service in a steel project. Steel Mind Engineers engineers set the loads, choose the frame and size every member, then show you a 3D model for approval before any steel is cut.
alt: Engineer reviewing a 3D steel frame design in the Steel Mind Engineers office.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind Engineers work with my consultant?
faq.a: Yes. Steel Mind Engineers coordinates with your consultant and works to the approved requirements.
It depends on the size and complexity. The engineer gives a date with the quote.

blocks.text: The design stage decides what the building is: its frame type, its member sizes, its connections and its foundation loads. A good design uses steel where it is needed and nowhere else.

Engineers study your use, size, site and budget. They set the loads from the structure, wind, rain, roof use, cranes and equipment. They choose the frame and size each column, rafter and brace. They prepare a 3D model for your review. A second engineer checks the design before release.
You receive a 3D model, general arrangement drawings and the anchor bolt plan for your foundation contractor.
The designer stays available during fabrication and erection and answers site questions the same day.
